build.description: Orchestrator agent. Splits work into independent units, delegates to subagents, integrates their results, and implements small changes directly.

explore.description: Read-only search agent. Locates code and configuration across the project and installed dependency source, then returns a condensed digest with absolute paths and line anchors.

general.description: General-purpose executor. Carries out one scoped unit of work end to end and reports the real output it produced.

sage.description: Read-only senior advisor. Owns the team's judgment, world knowledge and approach specification: analyzes tradeoffs, returns the decision-complete plan for how the work should be built, diagnoses hard failures, and reviews changes for defects and risk.

browse.description: Browser automation agent. Drives a real Chromium browser to navigate pages, read and extract content, fill forms, click through flows, and capture screenshots; reports every finding anchored to URL + selector + quote.
